description: Main React component for the recipe explorer app, managing state, data fetching, filtering, and rendering child components.

methods.name: loadInitial
methods.description: Fetches initial recipes, cuisines, ingredients, and loads favorites from localStorage.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Adds or removes a recipe from favorites and updates localStorage.

methods.name: openRecipeDetail
methods.description: Sets the selected recipe to show its details.

methods.name: closeRecipeDetail
methods.description: Clears the selected recipe to close the detail modal.
